before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the source data and calculate mean wait time for each month
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('年月', as_index=False)['平均待ち時間'].mean()

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(monthly['年月'], monthly['平均待ち時間'], marker='o')
plt.xlabel('年月')
plt.ylabel('平均待ち時間')
plt.title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間')
plt.ylim(0, max(60, monthly['平均待ち時間'].max()))
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
